multi_hop_questions.question: How does content addressing enable both tamper detection and incremental updates?
required_facts: Incremental updates only store new or modified blobs
Manifest root digest covers all layer digests

multi_hop_questions.question: How does selective loading reduce security risks while improving performance?
required_facts: Selective loading mounts only task-relevant content
Security model treats source content as data not instructions

multi_hop_questions.question: How does the builder pipeline ensure provenance is maintained from source to archive?
required_facts: Each TextUnit maintains provenance to its Resource
Evidence pointers link claims to source units
Builder records source inventory with digests
Provenance is stored as a blob in the archive
Builder must never silently drop provenance

multi_hop_questions.question: How do claims and evidence pointers work together with the trust chain?

Evidence pointers reference source unit IDs and line spans
Trust chain flows from source to consumer
